strings.擴大機瓦數＋喇叭靈敏度＋距離，算聆聽位置最大音量: Amp power + speaker sensitivity + distance gives the maximum level at the listening position
strings.公式：SPL = 靈敏度 + 10·log₁₀(瓦數) − 20·log₁₀(距: Formula: SPL = sensitivity + 10·log₁₀(watts) − 20·log₁₀(distance) + 10·log₁₀(number of speakers). Doubling power is +3 dB; doubling distance is −6 dB; two uncorrelated speakers add +3 dB.
strings.音樂的峰值比平均高出「動態」那麼多（流行約 12、爵士約 16、古典約 20 d: Music peaks exceed the average by the "dynamics" amount (about 12 dB for pop, 16 for jazz, 20 for classical). Headroom = max level − (average + dynamics); below 0 means momentary peaks clip at high volume. This is a free-field estimate without room reflections and ignores speaker compression and distortion.

strings.功率：8 Ω 額定 {} W，接 {} Ω 的理想值是 {} W（電壓不變、電流: Power: rated {} W at 8 Ω; the ideal value into {} Ω is {} W (same voltage, more current). A stiff power supply manages about 2× at most; follow the amp's spec, many amps only give 1.3–1.8×, so never exceed the spec sheet.
strings.功率：阻抗比 8 Ω 高時，電壓固定，功率約與阻抗成反比（{} W × 8 ÷: Power: above 8 Ω the voltage is fixed, so power is roughly inversely proportional to impedance ({} W × 8 ÷ {} Ω).
strings.阻尼係數 = 喇叭阻抗 ÷（擴大機輸出阻抗 + 喇叭線電阻）；擴大機輸出阻抗 =: Damping factor = speaker impedance ÷ (amp output impedance + speaker cable resistance); amp output impedance = 8 Ω ÷ the spec damping factor. Thin or long speaker cable eats the damping factor; above about 20 is enough for most speakers, go higher if you need tight bass control. Speaker cable resistance = 0.0172 × 2 × length ÷ cross-section (copper).
strings.依溫度換算聲速，距離、毫秒、頻率、波長互換: Converts distance, milliseconds, frequency and wavelength using the speed of sound at the given temperature
strings.聲速 c = 331.3 + 0.606 × 溫度(°C)，20 °C 約 34: Speed of sound c = 331.3 + 0.606 × temperature (°C); about 343 m/s at 20 °C. Delay (ms) = distance ÷ c × 1000; a 1 m difference between two speakers is about 2.9 ms; wavelength = c ÷ frequency. Change any field and its pair updates.
strings.dB ↔ 電壓／電流比 ↔ 功率比: dB ↔ voltage / current ratio ↔ power ratio
strings.電壓、電流（振幅）用 dB = 20·log₁₀(比值)；功率用 dB = 10: Voltage and current (amplitude) use dB = 20·log₁₀(ratio); power uses dB = 10·log₁₀(ratio). So +6 dB is 2× voltage and 4× power; +3 dB is 1.41× voltage and 2× power; +10 dB is 10× power.
